name: agentsurely
author: Nguyễn Thị Liễu
description: Performance bonds for ERC-8004 AI agents on Monad, verified by a Chainlink CRE workflow.

scripts.deploy:local: npm run deploy:local -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run seed:local -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk
scripts.deploy:monad: npm run deploy:monad -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk
scripts.forwarder:monad: npm run forwarder:monad -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk
scripts.test: npm test -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @agentsurely/sdk && npm run catalog:selftest -w @agentsurely/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @agentsurely/app
scripts.upgrade03:monad: npm run subs:monad -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk
scripts.playbooks:monad: npm run playbooks:monad -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk && npm run playbooks:publish -w @agentsurely/sdk -- --chain monad
scripts.jobs:monad: npm run jobs:monad -w @agentsurely/contracts && npm run sync -w @agentsurely/sdk
